description: This file defines the ReadableShopOrder class, which extends ReadableOrder and encapsulates order data including shipping summary, totals, and error message within the sales manager application.

classes.name: ReadableShopOrder
classes.description: A serializable class representing a read-only view of an order, including shipping summary, totals, and error messages.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the global error message related to the order.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets the global error message for the order.

methods.name: getGrandTotal
methods.description: Returns the grand total of the order as a string.

methods.name: setGrandTotal
methods.description: Sets the grand total of the order.

methods.name: getSubTotals
methods.description: Returns the list of order subtotal components.

methods.name: setSubTotals
methods.description: Sets the list of order subtotal components.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Returns the shipping summary for the order.

methods.name: setShippingSummary
methods.description: Sets the shipping summary for the order.
